recorded.rule: Q2 v2: a giveaway, read from the question's own text alone
recorded.prompt:q-duration-on-a-date: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.
recorded.pass:q-duration-on-a-date: an independent page-free reader (29-date-time-api q2), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-duration-on-a-date: from the question's text alone, the reader picked 'a'; the key is 'b'
recorded.because:q-duration-on-a-date: Restates the stem: 'thirty days after the date' repeats Duration.ofDays(30) and 'plus'; c introduces 'calendar month' not in the stem, b repeats nothing.

recorded.prompt:q-duration-on-a-date:a: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-duration-on-a-date:a: an independent reader (29-date-time-api q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-duration-on-a-date:a: ruled out: Pitfall 1: 'date.plus(Duration.ofDays(30)); // UnsupportedTemporalTypeException!' with date = LocalDate.of(2024, 1, 15); key point 3: 'you cannot add a Duration to a LocalDate'.
recorded.prompt:q-duration-on-a-date:c: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-duration-on-a-date:c: an independent reader (29-date-time-api q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-duration-on-a-date:c: ruled out: Same pitfall 1: it throws; the one-calendar-month result belongs to the fix 'date.plus(Period.ofMonths(1))'.
recorded.prompt:q-get-days:a: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-get-days:a: an independent reader (29-date-time-api q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-get-days:a: ruled out: 'Period.getDays() only returns the days COMPONENT, not the total: Period.of(1, 2, 3).getDays() = 3' and 'int daysComponent = period.getDays(); // 3' - 2 is the months component.
recorded.prompt:q-get-days:b: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.

recorded.outcome:q-get-days:b: ruled out: Same passage: 'Period.of(1, 2, 3).getDays() = 3 (not ~430!)'; Key Point 4 'Period components are independent ... stores ... separately' - no total/combined day count is returned.
